hook_en: Morning and night, there's reason to praise. 🙏
reflect_en: The psalmist says it is good to praise the LORD, to proclaim His loving devotion in the morning and His faithfulness at night. On the eve of Thanksgiving, whatever this week has held, you can open and close your day thanking Him for who He has been to you.
q_en: What is one thing you're thanking God for this week?
x_en: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High
tiktok: Start and end your day with gratitude 🙏 Psalm 92:1–2 — It is good to praise the LORD
yt_title: It Is Good to Praise the LORD | Psalm 92:1–2 #Shorts
li_open: Gratitude is a discipline before it is a feeling.
li_quote: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High
li_body: The psalmist built praise into both ends of the day: God's loving devotion in the morning and His faithfulness at night. Leaders who make room to thank God, and to celebrate answered prayers with their people, build teams that notice His faithfulness instead of only the next problem.
hook_es: Mañana y noche, hay motivos para alabar. 🙏
reflect_es: El salmista dice que bueno es alabar a Jehová, y anunciar por la mañana Su misericordia y Su verdad en las noches. A mitad de esta semana, sea lo que sea que hayas vivido, puedes comenzar y terminar tu día dándole gracias por todo lo que Él ha sido para ti.
q_es: ¿Por qué le quieres dar gracias a Dios esta semana?
x_es: Bueno es alabar a Jehová, y cantar salmos a tu nombre, oh Altísimo
key_en: It is good to praise the LORD
